summary.text: Dan Hartong, who appeared on the America First Party Nebraska line, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Nebraska's 1st Congressional District to Mike Flood.
Hartong received 1.7% of the vote to Mike Flood's 50%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
No campaign website, candidate survey responses, or other public statements were found.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska, 2026
